summary: Android adds an outlined warning-triangle icon to the agent-limit banner and indents its text; React has no icon.
The banner link text "Upgrade for more" is bold on React but regular-weight on Android.
The Name placeholder differs: React shows "e.g. Alice", while Android shows "e.g. Noel". Android also adds "(optional)" to the Description label.
Android's Description textarea is shorter and omits React's lower-right resize handle; the character counter consequently sits at a different vertical position.

The Runtime section differs substantially: Android adds a peach "Runtime configuration is unavailable." notice, removes the required asterisk, shows "Codex CLI" instead of the gray "Select..." placeholder, and shifts the field downward.
likelyCauses: Android uses a different warning-banner component with an icon that is absent from React.
The banner's secondary text uses a different font-weight token on Android.
Placeholder and runtime values are populated from platform-specific data rather than shared defaults.
Android applies different textarea sizing and resize-affordance styling.
Android spacing tokens differ, and the additional Runtime notice changes the vertical flow.

Align vertical spacing tokens between the banner, Computer field, Name field, Description field, and Runtime section.

cases.title: Card message header, three tags
cases.note: RFC 082 v2.0 (§4.8): a card message's header: the title in the Card title style (CardTitle, 600), the subtitle muted, three tags as soft badges in their tone (danger, warning, neutral; info, success, neutral); no colour on the header itself. React-only: the mobile App draws card messages from the shared contract vectors (messageCard.v1.vector.json).

cases.title: Card message header, three tags (dark)
cases.note: The header case in the dark theme: the tags keep their status tones.

cases.title: Card message Fields, phone width
cases.note: RFC 082 v2.0: Fields as raft-ui DescriptionList direction=horizontal on a phone-width card: below 384px each label sits above its value; values wrap, never truncate; mono values in the code face.

cases.title: Card message Markdown with a list and a quote
cases.note: RFC 082 v2.0: a Markdown element drawn by the message renderer restricted to the card subset: bold, inline code, a nested list, a quote, a link; @name stays text (no chip); then a Divider and a button.

cases.title: Action card, expired after 30 days (agent card, opened)
cases.note: #proj-apps:#40 (Kirby 7579a290): an agent's channel:create card no one completed within 30 days, as the server serves it (state expired, expiresAt).
